title: List auto-placed junctions and their net names
summary: Finds the automatic junctions on a schematic sheet from its wire connection points and names the net of each by matching wire handles with the compiled netlist.
phrasings: find all junctions on a schematic sheet
get the net name at a wire T-connection
map a schematic wire to its compiled net
list wire connection points with coordinates

commands.name: GetAllAutoJunctions
commands.description: List auto-placed junctions of the current sheet with their net names
